title: Span Telemetry Fabric and SLO Signalizer
creator: Aisha Gomez
description: Build a standardized Span Telemetry Fabric to centralize trace hook ingestion, enrich spans with request-level metadata, derive SLO signals from combined trace/metric/log streams, and power burn-rate + anomaly-based paging. Goal is consistent SLO attribution across hosted/dedicated/private deployments and to reduce false-positive pages by 40%.
acceptance_criteria: New trace hooks deployed to runtime sidecars that emit standardized span attributes (customer_id, model_variant, route, sampling_reason)
Enrichment pipeline attaches routing and cache-hint attributes within 100ms of span ingestion for 95% of traces
SLO Signalizer produces a time-series SLI stream (latency_p95, error_rate_5m) partitioned by model_variant and route
Burn-rate alerting rules can be configured per-customer and respect quiet-hours and escalation policies
End-to-end test harness validates alert firing and suppression behavior with synthetic injection scenarios
tech_notes: We will reuse the existing ingest Kafka topic but add a compacted span-metadata store in Cassandra to join short-lived enrichments
Prefer agent-side lightweight enrichment to reduce join cardinality downstream; fallback to enrichment microservice if agent lacks metadata
SLO Signalizer will compute windowed SLIs using a streaming Flink job with deterministic watermarking for late-arriving spans
Anomaly detection will start with a simple EWMA + MAD gating and later evaluate autoencoder-based residuals (MLR experiment)
Burn-rate thresholds are derived from active error budgets stored in the SLO service; the Signalizer will emit burn-rate metrics as timeseries to the alerting platform
progress_updates: 2026-02-22: Architecture sync with Observability, Runtime, and Platform teams. Agreed to agent-side minimal enrichment plus enrichment service for legacy nodes.
2026-02-28: Prototype Flink job producing per-route latency_p95 and error_rate_5m streams; local end-to-end test with synthetic span replay succeeded.
2026-03-05: Instrumented runtime sidecar to emit sampling_reason and model_variant; initial rollout to dev and staging clusters (10% traffic).
2026-03-10: Early anomaly detector tuning reduced false positives in staging by ~23%; discovered noisy legacy route causing skew (follow-up task created).
review_feedback: PM: Ensure SLO Signalizer supports per-tenant overrides and rollout flags for Dedicated customers.
Security: Confirm that span-level PII never leaves the agent; add an opt-out and scrub-by-default policy.
Design/Console: Need a dashboard wireframe that surfaces per-customer burn-rate with suggested remediation steps and historical context.
SRE: Request circuit-breaker around enrichment service to avoid downstream overload during high ingest events.
risks_and_mitigation: Risk: Increased cardinality from adding route+variant tags could spike storage and query costs. Mitigation: enforce cardinality limits and sample low-traffic partitions for deep diagnostics.
Risk: Late-arriving spans causing SLI drift. Mitigation: use deterministic watermarking and backfill window reconcilers that mark metrics as provisional for 5 minutes.
Risk: Pager fatigue if anomaly model underfits. Mitigation: start with conservative EWMA thresholds, gate ML models behind rollout flags, and run parallel A/B evaluation.
test_plan: Unit tests for span attribute schema and validation
Integration tests: synthetic span replays that assert enrichment, SLI derivation, and burn-rate emission
Chaos test: high-ingest spike to validate enrichment service circuit-breaker and graceful degradation path
Canary: staged rollout to 10% of runtime sidecars, monitor false-positive rate and SLO accuracy before full rollout
rollout_plan: Phase 1 (dev/staging): deploy agent changes and Flink job, verify metric parity (2 weeks)
Phase 2 (canary): enable on 10% of production routes; monitor burn-rate alerts and ops feedback (1 week)
Phase 3 (gradual): expand to remaining routes with tenant-specific opt-outs and Dedicated tenancy flags (2-3 weeks)
Phase 4 (hardening): enable ML anomaly detector behind flag and compare against baseline for 2 weeks
